- *Structured data that still holds a template's own tag is reported.* When a page's template fails to fill
  a value such as the business name, and leaves something like `{{ studio.name }}` inside quotes, the
  structured data is still valid, so nothing flagged it before. The report now names the field and the tag.
  A tag inside running text, such as a code example in an article, is not flagged.
- *A finished audit is in Reports the moment it reads as finished.* The engine marked an audit finished a
  moment before saving its report, so something checking at that instant could find Reports without it.
  The report is now saved first.
- *One crash, one crash report.* If Docket's crash recorder was started twice in one run, a single crash
  could be written down twice. It is now recorded once.

99 checks across 13 areas.
